headline: Weathered Expanse Now the Bloodiest Field; Fishermans Row Rekindles
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has leapt to the fore since our last edition: some twenty-two thousand Warden and eighteen thousand Colonial casualties in the past day, nine base actions within two hours of press, and fighting still under way as this sheet goes to bed, with Necropolis, Spirit Watch, and Wightwalk the busiest points. Fishermans Row, reported still but three hours ago, has rekindled — two actions inside two hours, thirty-three in the day, losses climbing evenly on both sides, Arcadia and Peripti Landing the busiest works. The Dead Lands cool, their hourly toll ebbing, though Callahan's Boot passed to Warden hands; the ground there stands six Colonial to five. Lykos Isle is now wholly Colonial, seven works of seven, after twenty-one actions in the day. Godcrofts, solidly Warden ground, stirs likewise — five actions in two hours at Exile and Lipsia, the last at press time. Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf fight on; Tempest Island, lately aflame, has gone quiet some four hours; Linn Mercy burns near eight hundred the hour without a work changing hands. The ledger: two hundred fifty Colonial works to one hundred eighty-five Warden, three in ruin. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-eighth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
